config:

---

    direction LR
    CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places

    ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_ITEM : contains

    PRODUCT ||--o{ ORDER_ITEM : "appears in"

    CUSTOMER {
        string id PK
        string name
        string email UK
        datetime created_at
    }
    ADDRESS {
        string id PK
        string customer_id FK
        string street
        string city
        string country
        string postal_code
    }
    ORDER {
        string id PK
        string customer_id FK
        datetime created_at
        string status
        decimal total
    }
    ORDER_ITEM {
        string id PK
        string order_id FK
        string product_id FK
        int quantity
        decimal unit_price
    }
    PRODUCT {
        string id PK
        string category_id FK
        string title
        decimal price
        int stock
    }
    CATEGORY {
        string id PK
        string name
        string slug UK
    }
    PAYMENT {
        string id PK
        string order_id FK
        decimal amount
